English: Eastern Africa: Heavy rains and flooding Flash Update #2 (10 May 2024)
Kiswahili: Afrika Mashariki: Mvua kubwa na mafuriko Sasisho la Flash #2 (10 Mei 2024)

English: An Analysis on Cyclic Variations that Indicate a Catastrophic Famine Event in East Africa in 2028-2035
Kiswahili: Uchambuzi wa Tofauti za Baiskeli ambazo Zinaonyesha Tukio la Janga la Njaa katika Afrika Mashariki mnamo 2028-2035

English: India to send US$ 1 million flood relief assistance to Kenya
Kiswahili: India kutuma msaada wa dola za Marekani milioni 1 wa misaada ya mafuriko nchini Kenya

English: Navigating Cultural and Traditional Barriers in Qualitative Data Collection
Kiswahili: Kuelekeza Vizuizi vya Kitamaduni na Kijadi katika Ukusanyaji wa Data Bora

English: New IRC data: Horn of Africa drought leading to increasing violence against women and girls
Kiswahili: Data mpya ya IRC: Ukame wa Pembe ya Afrika unaosababisha kuongezeka kwa ukatili dhidi ya wanawake na wasichana

English: He and his family were removed from the eligibility list after being classified by the authorities as having Kenyan citizenship.
Kiswahili: Yeye na familia yake waliondolewa kwenye orodha ya wanaostahiki baada ya kuainishwa na mamlaka kuwa na uraia wa Kenya.

English: Abdullahi denies this, saying neither he, his wife, nor his mother are Kenyan citizens, and that his children are all still minors.
Kiswahili: Abdullahi anakanusha hili, akisema yeye, mke wake, wala mama yake si raia wa Kenya, na kwamba watoto wake wote bado ni watoto.

English: He says the income is too little to cover food, basic needs, and the fees for five of his children who were attending Koranic school costing $35 a month.
Kiswahili: Anasema kipato ni kidogo sana kuweza kugharamia chakula, mahitaji ya kimsingi, na ada kwa watoto wake watano waliokuwa wakisoma shule ya Kurani inayogharimu dola 35 kwa mwezi.

English: He has repeatedly visited aid agency offices seeking answers – but often can’t even gain access to the guarded compounds.
Kiswahili: Ametembelea mara kwa mara ofisi za mashirika ya misaada kutafuta majibu - lakini mara nyingi hawezi hata kupata misombo ya ulinzi.

English: Abdullahi fled conflict in 1994 in rural Lower Juba region in southern Somalia, where his family had depended on livestock that they have lost.
Kiswahili: Abdullahi alikimbia vita mwaka 1994 katika eneo la vijijini la Juba ya Chini kusini mwa Somalia, ambapo familia yake ilikuwa ikitegemea mifugo ambayo imepoteza.

English: Full details of those removed and the reasons were not available for this report.
Kiswahili: Maelezo kamili ya walioondolewa na sababu hazikupatikana kwa ripoti hii.

English: Camp leaders say some of those removed were reclassified by DRS as Kenyan citizens.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa kambi hiyo wanasema baadhi ya walioondolewa waliwekwa bayana na DRS kuwa raia wa Kenya.

English: Abshiro Adan Ibrahim, 50, applied for citizenship and became a Kenyan citizen in 2025 after living in the Dadaab refugee camps for 32 years.
Kiswahili: Abshiro Adan Ibrahim, 50, aliomba uraia na kuwa raia wa Kenya mnamo 2025 baada ya kuishi katika kambi za wakimbizi za Dadaab kwa miaka 32.

English: She continued receiving 100 kilograms of food, 16 litres of cooking oil, and $30 in bi-monthly cash support after her citizenship was granted.
Kiswahili: Aliendelea kupokea kilo 100 za chakula, lita 16 za mafuta ya kupikia, na dola 30 za usaidizi wa kila mwezi wa pesa taslimu baada ya uraia wake kupewa.

English: You can imagine a family of eight losing their food support.
Kiswahili: Unaweza kufikiria familia ya watu wanane ikipoteza msaada wao wa chakula.

English: Neighbours who receive food bring us some, and others bring oil.
Kiswahili: Majirani wanaopokea chakula hutuletea, na wengine huleta mafuta.

English: Abshiro had hoped that acquiring citizenship would help her find work to support her family, as the aid they received was not enough.
Kiswahili: Abshiro alikuwa na matumaini kwamba kupata uraia kungemsaidia kupata kazi ya kukimu familia yake, kwani msaada waliopokea haukutosha.

English: I took that step for my five children who depend on me.
Kiswahili: Nilichukua hatua hiyo kwa watoto wangu watano wanaonitegemea.

English: They have no father and no support.
Kiswahili: Hawana baba na hawana msaada.

English: Abshiro fled insecurity in 1992 in Sanguuni near Kismayo, where her family had relied on farming four hectares of land.
Kiswahili: Abshiro alikimbia ukosefu wa usalama mwaka 1992 huko Sanguuni karibu na Kismayo, ambapo familia yake ilitegemea kilimo cha hekta nne za ardhi.

English: Life in the camps depends on food and security.
Kiswahili: Maisha katika kambi hutegemea chakula na usalama.

English: If food is removed, there is a serious problem.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa chakula kinaondolewa, kuna shida kubwa.

English: Refugees in Dadaab currently receive limited water, healthcare, and education services, but continuing food and cash assistance remain central to their survival.
Kiswahili: Wakimbizi katika Dadaab kwa sasa wanapokea huduma chache za maji, afya, na elimu, lakini msaada wa chakula na pesa taslimu unaoendelea unasalia kuwa msingi wa maisha yao.

English: Over the past three years, there has been an incremental reduction in services, food rations and cash support affecting the refugee population in Dadaab.
Kiswahili: Katika kipindi cha miaka mitatu iliyopita, kumekuwa na punguzo la ongezeko la huduma, mgao wa chakula na usaidizi wa fedha unaoathiri idadi ya wakimbizi huko Dadaab.

English: The Government of Kenya developed a National Anticipatory Action Roadmap with support from partners including the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO),3 which contributed to the co‑development of triggers and thresholds guiding early action.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya ilibuni Mwongozo wa Kitaifa wa Hatua ya Kutarajia kwa usaidizi kutoka kwa washirika likiwemo Shirika la Chakula na Kilimo la Umoja wa Mataifa (FAO),3 ambao ulichangia katika uundaji wa vichochezi na vizingiti vinavyoelekeza hatua za mapema.

English: Triggers for the nine arid counties were activated based on the standardized precipitation index and vegetation condition index, enabling counties and organizations to commence anticipatory actions.
Kiswahili: Vichochezi vya kaunti tisa zenye ukame viliamilishwa kwa kuzingatia faharasa sanifu ya kunyesha na hali ya uoto, kuwezesha kaunti na mashirika kuanza vitendo vya kutarajia.

English: In response, through SFERA, the Government of Belgium contributed USD 500 000 to FAO to implement a project, entitled “Safeguarding livelihoods and increasing immediate food access for vulnerable rural households affected by forecasted drought through anticipatory action”.
Kiswahili: Katika kukabiliana na hali hiyo, kupitia SFERA, Serikali ya Ubelgiji ilichangia USD 500 000 kwa FAO kutekeleza mradi, unaoitwa "Kulinda riziki na kuongeza upatikanaji wa chakula mara moja kwa kaya za vijijini zilizo hatarini zilizoathiriwa na ukame uliotabiriwa kupitia hatua za kutarajia".

English: Through the project, FAO aims to deliver unconditional cash transfers and enhance access to animal health services for vulnerable households in Garissa, Isiolo, Samburu and Tana River counties.
Kiswahili: Kupitia mradi huo, FAO inalenga kuwasilisha uhamisho wa pesa bila masharti na kuimarisha upatikanaji wa huduma za afya ya wanyama kwa kaya zilizo hatarini katika kaunti za Garissa, Isiolo, Samburu na Tana River.

English: Cash assistance will be provided to enable 2 000 vulnerable families to immediately access food and address urgent basic needs without having to engage in negative coping mechanisms, such as selling animals or withdrawing children from school.
Kiswahili: Usaidizi wa pesa taslimu utatolewa ili kuwezesha familia 2,000 zilizo katika mazingira magumu kupata chakula mara moja na kushughulikia mahitaji ya dharura bila kujihusisha na mbinu mbaya za kukabiliana nazo, kama vile kuuza wanyama au kuwaondoa watoto shuleni.

English: Additionally, 400 000 animals will be dewormed, treated against internal and external parasites and given multivitamins to sustain milk and meat production and survive through this period, directly preserving the livelihoods and nutritional well-being of 4 000 vulnerable households.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, wanyama 400,000 watatiwa dawa ya minyoo, watatibiwa dhidi ya vimelea vya ndani na nje na kupewa multivitamini ili kuendeleza uzalishaji wa maziwa na nyama na kuishi katika kipindi hiki, kuhifadhi moja kwa moja maisha na ustawi wa lishe wa kaya 4,000 zilizo katika mazingira magumu.

English: By protecting livestock health and supporting families with cash transfers, FAO and partners will help 6 000 pastoral households survive the drought and preserve their resilience and dignity in the face of disasters and climate shocks.
Kiswahili: Kwa kulinda afya ya mifugo na kusaidia familia kwa uhamisho wa fedha, FAO na washirika watasaidia kaya 6,000 za wafugaji kustahimili ukame na kuhifadhi ustahimilivu na heshima yao katika kukabiliana na majanga na majanga ya hali ya hewa.

English: Breastfeeding is foundational for both child survival and maternal health.
Kiswahili: Kunyonyesha ni msingi wa maisha ya mtoto na afya ya uzazi.

English: It is the first food system and a child’s first vaccine, offering unparalleled nutrition and immune protection.Importantly, breastfeeding is also climate-smart — a renewable, zero-waste, low-carbon act that benefits both people and the planet.
Kiswahili: Ni mfumo wa kwanza wa chakula na chanjo ya kwanza ya mtoto, inayotoa lishe isiyo na kifani na ulinzi wa kinga. Muhimu, kunyonyesha pia kunazingatia hali ya hewa - kitendo kinachoweza kurejeshwa, kisicho na sifuri, cha kaboni ya chini ambacho kinanufaisha watu na sayari.

English: In the fragile and climate-affected context of the Mandera Triangle — where the borders of Kenya, Ethiopia, and Somalia meet — breastfeeding is a vital lifeline for infants and mothers.
Kiswahili: Katika mazingira dhaifu na yaliyoathiriwa na hali ya hewa ya Pembetatu ya Mandera - ambapo mipaka ya Kenya, Ethiopia, na Somalia inakutana - kunyonyesha ni njia muhimu ya maisha kwa watoto wachanga na akina mama.

English: However, these populations face challenges such as weak health infrastructure, food insecurity, and frequent displacement.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, watu hawa wanakabiliwa na changamoto kama vile miundombinu dhaifu ya afya, uhaba wa chakula, na kuhama mara kwa mara.

English: Hanaano which means ‘to nurture’ in Somali is a three-year cross-border nutritionsensitive initiative, supporting women in navigating these challenges, promoting breastfeeding as a culturally rooted and climate-resilient practice.
Kiswahili: Hanaano ambayo ina maana ya 'kulea' katika Kisomali ni mpango wa miaka mitatu wa kuzingatia lishe kuvuka mipaka, kusaidia wanawake katika kukabiliana na changamoto hizi, kuhimiza unyonyeshaji kama desturi iliyokita mizizi na kustahimili hali ya hewa.

English: The Hanaano programme is part of Ireland’s contribution to the Global Action Plan (GAP) on Child Wasting, a collaborative initiative aimed at addressing and reducing child wasting globally.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Hanaano ni sehemu ya mchango wa Ireland katika Mpango wa Utekelezaji wa Kimataifa (GAP) kuhusu Upotevu wa Mtoto, mpango shirikishi unaolenga kushughulikia na kupunguza upotevu wa watoto duniani kote.

English: Samburu County, Kenya -In Lolmolong village, in Samburu County in northern Kenya, Neshoo Leaungokiok laboured through the night, far from the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Samburu, Kenya -Katika kijiji cha Lolmolong, katika Kaunti ya Samburu kaskazini mwa Kenya, Neshoo Leaungokiok alifanya kazi usiku kucha, mbali na kituo cha afya cha karibu.

English: With no transport available and a six-hour journey on foot to reach care, she had no choice but to give birth at home, assisted only by a traditional birth attendant.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hakukuwa na usafiri na mwendo wa saa sita kwa miguu kufika kwenye huduma, hakuwa na budi ila kujifungulia nyumbani, akisaidiwa na mkunga wa jadi pekee.

English: In this remote part of Kenya, long distances, difficult terrain and insecurity continue to limit access to skilled care during childbirth, placing mothers and newborns at significant risk.
Kiswahili: Katika sehemu hii ya mbali ya Kenya, umbali mrefu, ardhi ngumu na ukosefu wa usalama unaendelea kuzuia upatikanaji wa huduma za kitaalamu wakati wa kujifungua, hivyo kuwaweka akina mama na watoto wachanga katika hatari kubwa.

English: As labour intensified, Lucy Makena, a reproductive health officer from a nearby mobile outreach clinic supported by World Health Organization (WHO), reached the home.
Kiswahili: Uchungu ulipokuwa ukiongezeka, Lucy Makena, afisa wa afya ya uzazi kutoka kliniki inayohamishika ya karibu inayoungwa mkono na Shirika la Afya Duniani (WHO), alifika nyumbani hapo.

English: These clinics operate from off-road trucks fitted with a consultation room, patient beds, a small laboratory, and a pharmacy, designed to bring essential care directly to communities far from any permanent facility.
Kiswahili: Kliniki hizi zinafanya kazi kutoka kwa malori ya nje ya barabara yaliyo na chumba cha mashauriano, vitanda vya wagonjwa, maabara ndogo, na duka la dawa, iliyoundwa kuleta huduma muhimu moja kwa moja kwa jamii zilizo mbali na kituo chochote cha kudumu.

English: Trained in emergency obstetric and newborn care through programmes also supported by WHO, she quickly assessed Leaungokiok’s condition and began monitoring the progress of labour.
Kiswahili: Akiwa amefunzwa katika utunzaji wa dharura wa uzazi na watoto wachanga kupitia programu zinazoungwa mkono na WHO, alitathmini haraka hali ya Leaungokiok na kuanza kufuatilia maendeleo ya leba.

English: In settings where complications can go unrecognized and timely care is often out of reach, skilled support can mean the difference between life and death.
Kiswahili: Katika mazingira ambapo matatizo yanaweza kwenda bila kutambuliwa na huduma ya wakati mara nyingi haipatikani, usaidizi wenye ujuzi unaweza kumaanisha tofauti kati ya maisha na kifo.

English: With Makena’s support and care, Leaungokiok safely delivered a healthy baby girl.
Kiswahili: Kwa usaidizi na utunzaji wa Makena, Leaungokiok alijifungua salama mtoto wa kike mwenye afya njema.

English: Acting immediately, Lucy administered lifesaving medicine to control the bleeding.
Kiswahili: Kuchukua hatua mara moja, Lucy alitoa dawa ya kuokoa maisha ili kudhibiti damu.

English: She also supported the mother to initiate breastfeeding within the first hour, an essential step in protecting the newborn’s health.
Kiswahili: Pia alimsaidia mama kuanza kunyonyesha ndani ya saa ya kwanza, hatua muhimu katika kulinda afya ya mtoto mchanga.

English: I am grateful to have delivered safely and to have a healthy baby,” says Leaungokiok, cradling her daughter.
Kiswahili: Ninashukuru kujifungua salama na kupata mtoto mwenye afya njema,” anasema Leaungokiok, akimkumbatia bintiye.

English: For Makena, moments like this reflect the importance of reaching women wherever they are.
Kiswahili: Kwa Makena, nyakati kama hizi zinaonyesha umuhimu wa kuwafikia wanawake popote walipo.

English: Through collaboration with county health authorities, WHO is supporting the expansion of emergency obstetric and newborn care services in northern Kenya, including training health workers and strengthening outreach services to reach remote communities.
Kiswahili: Kupitia ushirikiano na mamlaka za afya za kaunti, WHO inaunga mkono upanuzi wa huduma za dharura za uzazi na watoto wachanga kaskazini mwa Kenya, ikiwa ni pamoja na kutoa mafunzo kwa wahudumu wa afya na kuimarisha huduma za kufikia jamii za mbali.

English: While access to skilled birth care remains limited in some parts of the African Region, targeted investments in health workforce training and service delivery are helping to close the gap, as in Leaungokiok’s case.
Kiswahili: Ingawa upatikanaji wa huduma ya uzazi yenye ujuzi bado ni mdogo katika baadhi ya maeneo ya Kanda ya Afrika, uwekezaji unaolengwa katika mafunzo ya wafanyakazi wa afya na utoaji wa huduma unasaidia kuziba pengo hilo, kama ilivyo kwa Leaungokiok.

English: As 2025 unfolded amid growing regional uncertainty and humanitarian challenges, the ICRC Nairobi Regional Delegation continued to work alongside partners and communities to uphold humanity where it was needed most.
Kiswahili: Mwaka wa 2025 ulipoendelea huku kukiwa na hali ya kutokuwa na uhakika na changamoto za kibinadamu zinazoongezeka kikanda, Ujumbe wa ICRC wa Mkoa wa Nairobi uliendelea kufanya kazi pamoja na washirika na jamii ili kudumisha ubinadamu mahali palipohitajika zaidi.

English: Through humanitarian diplomacy, engagement, and operational support, our efforts remained focused on protecting dignity, strengthening respect for International Humanitarian Law, and responding to the evolving needs of people affected by conflict and violence across the region.
Kiswahili: Kupitia diplomasia ya kibinadamu, ushirikishwaji, na usaidizi wa kiutendaji, juhudi zetu zilibaki zikilenga katika kulinda utu, kuimarisha heshima kwa Sheria ya Kimataifa ya Kibinadamu, na kujibu mahitaji yanayoendelea ya watu walioathiriwa na migogoro na vurugu katika eneo lote.

English: While Kenya demonstrates sustained steady economic growth, the gains remain uneven.
Kiswahili: Huku Kenya ikionyesha ukuaji endelevu wa uchumi, mafanikio bado hayafanani.

English: Poverty, inequality and regional disparities persist, especially in arid and semi-arid counties, which cover 80% of the country’s land mass.
Kiswahili: Umaskini, ukosefu wa usawa na tofauti za kikanda zinaendelea, haswa katika kaunti kame na nusu kame, ambazo huchukua 80% ya ardhi yote ya nchi.

English: Societal gaps continue to limit the full participation of women, and other marginalised groups, and they suffer greater hurdles to recover from crises, including exclusion from assistance, especially material assistance.
Kiswahili: Mapengo ya kijamii yanaendelea kupunguza ushiriki kamili wa wanawake, na makundi mengine yaliyotengwa, na wanapata vikwazo vikubwa vya kujikwamua kutokana na matatizo, ikiwa ni pamoja na kutengwa na usaidizi, hasa msaada wa nyenzo.

English: Climate shocks, including recurring droughts and floods, are intensifying existing vulnerabilities and eroding household resilience.
Kiswahili: Matukio ya hali ya hewa, ikiwa ni pamoja na ukame na mafuriko ya mara kwa mara, yanazidisha udhaifu uliopo na kumomonyoa ustahimilivu wa kaya.

English: In times of crisis, communities in need of support require assistance that is versatile to suit their needs and support recovery.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa shida, jamii zinazohitaji usaidizi zinahitaji usaidizi ambao unaweza kukidhi mahitaji yao na kusaidia ahueni.

English: In this context, the Kenya Cash Consortium (KCC) plays a critical role in supporting crisis-affected communities to meet their most urgent needs, as they define and prioritise them, in a flexible, dignified manner.
Kiswahili: Katika muktadha huu, Muungano wa Fedha wa Kenya (KCC) una jukumu muhimu katika kusaidia jamii zilizoathiriwa na mgogoro ili kukidhi mahitaji yao ya dharura, huku wakiyafafanua na kuyapa kipaumbele, kwa njia inayoweza kunyumbulika na yenye heshima.

English: Since 2019, the KCC has been continuously providing timely, life-saving cash assistance to communities across Kenya.
Kiswahili: Tangu 2019, KCC imekuwa ikitoa usaidizi wa pesa kwa wakati unaofaa kwa jamii kote nchini Kenya.

English: Led by Acted in partnership with the ASAL Humanitarian Network, Oxfam Kenya, Concern Worldwide and IMPACT Initiatives, the KCC’s objective is to deliver timely cash assistance to communities affected by various shocks including natural disasters, conflict and displacement.
Kiswahili: Ikiongozwa na Kutenda kwa ushirikiano na Mtandao wa Kibinadamu wa ASAL, Oxfam Kenya, Concern Worldwide na IMPACT Initiatives, lengo la KCC ni kutoa usaidizi wa pesa taslimu kwa wakati kwa jamii zilizoathiriwa na majanga mbalimbali ikiwa ni pamoja na majanga ya asili, migogoro na kuhama makazi yao.

English: Over the years, the KCC has developed tools, systems and mechanisms to provide targeted and timely multi-sectoral responses based on needs prioritisation and continuous market monitoring, enabling the consortium to offer assistance to over 500,000 individuals.
Kiswahili: Kwa miaka mingi, KCC imeunda zana, mifumo na mbinu za kutoa majibu yaliyolengwa na kwa wakati mwafaka ya sekta mbalimbali kulingana na kipaumbele cha mahitaji na ufuatiliaji endelevu wa soko, kuwezesha muungano huo kutoa usaidizi kwa zaidi ya watu 500,000.

English: The KCC works through a locally-led approach with more than 30 local NGOs engaged in response delivery and county-level monitoring, data collection and coordination with county governments.
Kiswahili: KCC inafanya kazi kupitia mkabala unaoongozwa na wenyeji na zaidi ya NGOs 30 za ndani zinazojishughulisha na utoaji wa majibu na ufuatiliaji wa ngazi ya kaunti, ukusanyaji wa data na uratibu na serikali za kaunti.

English: The KCC’s approach is guided by the understanding that how assistance is delivered, the scale of delivery, and what partners are engaged, account for the largest gains and losses in efficiency and effectiveness.
Kiswahili: Mtazamo wa KCC unaongozwa na ufahamu kwamba jinsi usaidizi unavyotolewa, ukubwa wa utoaji, na washirika gani wanashirikishwa, huchangia faida na hasara kubwa zaidi katika ufanisi na ufanisi.

English: In 2026, the KCC, with support from the European Commission (DG ECHO), is implementing an action focused on providing Multipurpose Cash Assistance (MPCA) to crisis–affected communities across Kenya.
Kiswahili: Mnamo 2026, KCC, kwa usaidizi wa Tume ya Ulaya (DG ECHO), inatekeleza hatua inayolenga kutoa Msaada wa Pesa Madhumuni (MPCA) kwa jamii zilizoathiriwa na shida kote nchini Kenya.

English: This includes communities across Kenya’s Arid and Semi-Arid lands affected by increasingly recurrent climate-related crises such as drought and flooding.
Kiswahili: Hii ni pamoja na jamii katika nchi Kame na Nusu Kame nchini Kenya zilizoathiriwa na majanga yanayohusiana na hali ya hewa yanayotokea mara kwa mara kama vile ukame na mafuriko.

English: Other key beneficiaries are refugees who, despite receiving protection and nutrition assistance, are at risk of falling further into vulnerability.
Kiswahili: Walengwa wengine wakuu ni wakimbizi ambao, licha ya kupokea msaada wa ulinzi na lishe, wako katika hatari ya kuangukia zaidi katika mazingira magumu.

English: These groups are referred through key protection and referral actors in Kenya to receive MPCA as an additional layer to support recovery.
Kiswahili: Makundi haya yanarejelewa kupitia wahusika wakuu wa ulinzi na rufaa nchini Kenya ili kupokea MPCA kama safu ya ziada ya kusaidia uokoaji.

English: Further, the KCC will continue critical work in disaster-preparedness in Kenya, leading on county-level and national-level stakeholder engagement to advocate for concrete policy and action to protect Kenyan communities from recurring or predictable crises.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, KCC itaendelea na kazi muhimu ya kujiandaa na maafa nchini Kenya, ikiongoza katika ushirikishwaji wa washikadau katika ngazi ya kaunti na kitaifa ili kutetea sera na hatua madhubuti za kulinda jamii za Kenya dhidi ya majanga ya mara kwa mara au yanayotabirika.

English: Abdirizak Kontoma, Kenya Cash Consortium Coordinator and Project Manager, on the goals of the 2026 action.
Kiswahili: Abdirizak Kontoma, Mratibu wa Kenya Cash Consortium na Meneja Mradi, kuhusu malengo ya hatua ya 2026.

English: Through this action, the KCC aims to reinforce its role as a provider of flexible, efficient humanitarian assistance, leveraging strong partnerships and coordination to maximise impact, strengthen resilience, and advance a more coherent and forward-looking response to recurrent crises in Kenya.
Kiswahili: Kupitia hatua hii, KCC inalenga kuimarisha jukumu lake kama mtoaji wa usaidizi wa kibinadamu unaobadilika na unaofaa, kutumia ushirikiano dhabiti na uratibu ili kuongeza athari, kuimarisha uthabiti, na kuendeleza mwitikio thabiti na unaotazamia mbele zaidi kwa mizozo ya mara kwa mara nchini Kenya.

English: In 2023, catalytic support from Google.org launched a groundbreaking partnership between WFP, the University of Oxford, and key regional institutions—IGAD’s Climate Prediction and Applications Centre (ICPAC), the Kenya Meteorological Department (KMD), and the Ethiopia Meteorological Institute (EMI).
Kiswahili: Mnamo 2023, usaidizi wa kichocheo kutoka Google.org ulizindua ushirikiano wa msingi kati ya WFP, Chuo Kikuu cha Oxford, na taasisi muhimu za kikanda-IGAD's Climate Prediction and Application Center (ICPAC), Idara ya Hali ya Hewa ya Kenya (KMD), na Taasisi ya Hali ya Hewa ya Ethiopia (EMI).

English: The goal: to harness machine learning to improve early warning systems for extreme weather in eastern Africa.
Kiswahili: Lengo: kutumia ujifunzaji wa mashine ili kuboresha mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema kwa hali mbaya ya hewa katika Afrika mashariki.

English: Through the Strengthening Early Warning Systems 1 A Conditional Generative Adversarial Network (CGAN) for climate forecasting is an advanced type of artificial intelligence that helps predict weather patterns by learning from past climate data.
Kiswahili: Kupitia Mifumo ya Kuimarisha Tahadhari ya Mapema 1 Mtandao wa Masharti ya Kuzalisha Masharti (CGAN) kwa utabiri wa hali ya hewa ni aina ya hali ya juu ya akili ya bandia ambayo husaidia kutabiri mifumo ya hali ya hewa kwa kujifunza kutoka kwa data ya zamani ya hali ya hewa.

English: This innovation empowers national meteorological services to produce accurate, timely forecasts using only a personal computer—eliminating the need for costly supercomputers and unlocking new potential for anticipatory action in climate-vulnerable regions.
Kiswahili: Ubunifu huu huwezesha huduma za kitaifa za hali ya hewa kutoa utabiri sahihi, kwa wakati ufaao kwa kutumia kompyuta ya kibinafsi pekee—kuondoa hitaji la kompyuta kubwa za gharama kubwa na kufungua uwezekano mpya wa hatua za kutazamia katika maeneo yenye mazingira magumu ya hali ya hewa.

English: This issue is particularly significant with regard to the provision of HIV and sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR) for young people in eastern and southern Africa.
Kiswahili: Suala hili ni muhimu hasa kuhusiana na utoaji wa VVU na afya ya ngono na uzazi na haki (SRHR) kwa vijana mashariki na kusini mwa Afrika.

English: This report explores the costs of inaction in not realising the HIV and SRHR needs of young people in Kenya, Rwanda and Uganda, focusing on costs related to: 1) adolescent pregnancies, 2) HIV acquisition and 3) gender-based violation.
Kiswahili: Ripoti hii inachunguza gharama za kutochukua hatua katika kutotambua mahitaji ya VVU na SRHR ya vijana nchini Kenya, Rwanda na Uganda, ikizingatia gharama zinazohusiana na: 1) mimba za utotoni, 2) kupata VVU na 3) ukiukaji wa kijinsia.

English: This provides a foundation for alternative policies to be costed to address these gaps and a true cost–benefit analysis to be conducted.
Kiswahili: Hili linatoa msingi kwa sera mbadala kugharamiwa kushughulikia mapengo haya na uchanganuzi wa kweli wa gharama na manufaa utakaofanywa.

English: NAIROBI, Kenya— Kenya is entering a decisive moment in its response to forced displacement.
Kiswahili: NAIROBI, Kenya- Kenya inaingia katika wakati madhubuti katika kukabiliana na kulazimishwa kuhama makazi yao.

English: As global aid budgets shrink, refugees and host communities are increasingly competing in the same thin markets and relying on the same under‑resourced schools, clinics, roads, and water systems, raising the stakes for local livelihoods.
Kiswahili: Kadiri bajeti za misaada ya kimataifa zinavyopungua, wakimbizi na jumuiya zinazowapokea wanazidi kushindana katika masoko nyembamba sawa na kutegemea shule zisizo na rasilimali, zahanati, barabara na mifumo ya maji, hivyo basi kuinua hali ya maisha ya wenyeji.

English: More than four out of five refugees in Kakuma, Kalobeyei, and Dadaab are multidimensionally poor, experiencing overlapping deprivations in education, employment, housing, water, and nutrition.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya wakimbizi wanne kati ya watano huko Kakuma, Kalobeyei, na Dadaab ni masikini wa pande nyingi, wanakabiliwa na kunyimwa kwa elimu, ajira, makazi, maji na lishe.

English: Host communities, particularly in Turkana, face similar hardship, reflecting longstanding development gaps.
Kiswahili: Jumuiya mwenyeji, haswa Turkana, zinakabiliwa na ugumu kama huo, unaoonyesha mapungufu ya muda mrefu ya maendeleo.

English: Because aid still accounted for about three quarters of total revenue for camp‑based refugees in 2024, these cuts translated directly into falling household incomes and weaker demand in local camp economies, squeezing host community livelihoods tied to trade, services, and casual work.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu misaada bado ilichangia takriban robo tatu ya mapato ya jumla ya wakimbizi waliokaa kambini mwaka wa 2024, upunguzaji huu ulitafsiri moja kwa moja katika kupungua kwa mapato ya kaya na mahitaji duni katika uchumi wa kambi za ndani, kubana riziki za jamii zinazohusishwa na biashara, huduma, na kazi za kawaida.

English: Refugee employment halved between survey waves, falling from 13% to 7% in camps and from 50% to 37% in urban areas.
Kiswahili: Ajira kwa wakimbizi ilipungua kwa nusu kati ya mawimbi ya utafiti, ikishuka kutoka 13% hadi 7% katika kambi na kutoka 50% hadi 37% katika maeneo ya mijini.

English: Overall, the results point to a sharp refugee labor market shock alongside limited absorptive capacity in host labor markets.
Kiswahili: Kwa ujumla, matokeo yanaonyesha mshtuko mkali wa soko la ajira la wakimbizi sambamba na uwezo mdogo wa kufyonza katika soko la ajira mwenyeji.

English: Structural barriers further constrain access to work.
Kiswahili: Vizuizi vya kimuundo vinazuia zaidi ufikiaji wa kazi.

English: Low female labor participation in camps reflects the intersection of care responsibilities, limited mobility, and weak job availability; host‑community women in lagging regions face similar barriers.
Kiswahili: Ushiriki mdogo wa kazi ya wanawake katika kambi huonyesha makutano ya majukumu ya utunzaji, uhamaji mdogo, na upatikanaji dhaifu wa kazi; wanawake wa jamii-wageni katika maeneo yaliyochelewa wanakabiliwa na vikwazo sawa.

English: Without deliberate investments in childcare, skills, and safe work opportunities, women risk exclusion from the gains of integration.
Kiswahili: Bila uwekezaji wa kimakusudi katika malezi ya watoto, ujuzi, na fursa salama za kazi, wanawake wanahatarisha kutengwa kutoka kwa mafanikio ya ujumuishaji.

English: Food prices also remain a persistent stressor, while excessive rainfall and flooding in 2024 disrupted livelihoods and damaged infrastructure, particularly affecting host communities reliant on agriculture and livestock.
Kiswahili: Bei ya vyakula pia inasalia kuwa mkazo unaoendelea, wakati mvua nyingi na mafuriko katika 2024 yalitatiza maisha na miundombinu iliyoharibiwa, haswa kuathiri jamii zinazotegemea kilimo na mifugo.

English: As incomes fall and food becomes less affordable, households increasingly resort to negative coping strategies, signaling eroding resilience.
Kiswahili: Kadiri mapato yanavyopungua na chakula kinapokuwa chini ya bei nafuu, kaya zinazidi kutumia mikakati mibaya ya kukabiliana na hali hiyo, kuashiria kumomonyoka kwa ustahimilivu.

English: Children are bearing the brunt:complementary evidencepoints to worsening nutrition outcomes, and suggest sustained nutritional stress rather than short‑term shocks alone.
Kiswahili: Watoto wanabeba mzigo huu:ushahidi wa nyongeza wa matokeo mabaya ya lishe, na kupendekeza dhiki endelevu ya lishe badala ya mishtuko ya muda mfupi pekee.

English: Gaps in nutrition service coverage further compound these risks.
Kiswahili: Mapungufu katika utoaji wa huduma ya lishe huongeza zaidi hatari hizi.

English: Mental‑health pressures amplify vulnerability, with rising symptoms of stress and anxiety undermining households’ ability to cope with shocks and invest in future livelihoods.
Kiswahili: Shinikizo la afya ya akili huongeza uwezekano wa kuathirika, huku dalili zinazoongezeka za dhiki na wasiwasi zikidhoofisha uwezo wa kaya wa kukabiliana na mishtuko na kuwekeza katika maisha ya baadaye.

English: The Shirika Plan marks a historic shift toward integrated, development‑oriented solutions.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Shiŕika unaashiria mabadiliko ya kihistoria kuelekea suluhu zilizounganishwa, zenye mwelekeo wa maendeleo.

English: While the policy framework is in place, implementation gaps, especially around mobility and work permits, continue to limit labor market access.
Kiswahili: Wakati mfumo wa sera upo, mapengo ya utekelezaji, hasa kuhusu uhamaji na vibali vya kufanya kazi, yanaendelea kupunguza upatikanaji wa soko la ajira.

English: Success will hinge on lowering barriers to work and mobility, crowding in private investment, and strengthening local ecosystems while maintaining targeted, shock‑responsive support to protect the most vulnerable during the transition.
Kiswahili: Mafanikio yatategemea kupunguza vizuizi vya kufanya kazi na uhamaji, msongamano katika uwekezaji wa kibinafsi, na kuimarisha mifumo ikolojia ya ndani huku tukidumisha usaidizi unaolengwa, unaoitikia mshtuko ili kulinda walio hatarini zaidi wakati wa mpito.

English: If the Shirika Plan can translate integration into real economic opportunity, Kenya can chart a shared development pathway in which refugees and host communities both thrive.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa Mpango wa Shirika unaweza kutafsiri ushirikiano katika fursa halisi ya kiuchumi, Kenya inaweza kupanga njia ya pamoja ya maendeleo ambapo wakimbizi na jamii zinazowahifadhi zitastawi.

English: As climate change driving up global temperatures, chronic heat will become increasingly unbearable for already exposed populations and regions, while also posing a growing threat to those that have historically been less affected.
Kiswahili: Mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa yanapozidisha viwango vya joto duniani, joto sugu litazidi kuwa lisilostahimilika kwa wakazi na maeneo ambayo tayari yameathiriwa, huku pia yakiwa ni tishio linaloongezeka kwa yale ambayo yameathiriwa kidogo kihistoria.

English: Unlike acute heatwaves, chronic heat refers to sustained periods of elevated temperatures that can silently undermine health and wellbeing of populations and ecosystem as well as critical sectors such as transport, energy, agriculture and infrastructure.
Kiswahili: Tofauti na mawimbi ya joto kali, joto sugu hurejelea vipindi endelevu vya viwango vya juu vya joto ambavyo vinaweza kudhoofisha afya na ustawi wa watu na mfumo ikolojia kimya kimya na sekta muhimu kama vile usafiri, nishati, kilimo na miundombinu.

English: A growing urban heat crisis is placing residents of informal settlements at particular risk in countries such as Kenya, the United Republic of Tanzania and Zimbabwe.
Kiswahili: Mgogoro unaoongezeka wa joto mijini unawaweka wakazi wa makazi yasiyo rasmi katika hatari fulani katika nchi kama vile Kenya, Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania na Zimbabwe.

English: Research in settlements such as Mathare in Nairobi and Kombo in Dar es Salaam shows that indoor temperatures are often higher than outdoor conditions, leading to chronic heat stress.
Kiswahili: Utafiti katika makazi kama vile Mathare huko Nairobi na Kombo jijini Dar es Salaam unaonyesha kuwa halijoto ya ndani ya nyumba mara nyingi ni ya juu kuliko hali ya nje, na kusababisha msongo wa joto sugu.

English: Nearly three-quarters of residents report experiencing heat-related health problems, including heat exhaustion, dehydration and skin conditions.
Kiswahili: Takriban robo tatu ya wakazi wanaripoti kukumbana na matatizo ya kiafya yanayohusiana na joto, ikiwa ni pamoja na uchovu wa joto, upungufu wa maji mwilini na hali ya ngozi.

English: Infants, older persons, and people living with chronic illnesses or disabilities face heightened risks, compounded by limited access to affordable clean water.
Kiswahili: Watoto wachanga, wazee, na watu wanaoishi na magonjwa sugu au ulemavu wanakabiliwa na hatari kubwa, ikichangiwa na upatikanaji mdogo wa maji safi kwa bei nafuu.

English: Studies also highlight the difficult choices households make to cope with extreme heat, with some families spending around one-sixth of their income on recurring cooling and water-related costs.
Kiswahili: Tafiti pia zinaangazia chaguo ngumu ambazo kaya hufanya ili kukabiliana na joto kali, huku baadhi ya familia zikitumia karibu moja ya sita ya mapato yao kwa gharama za kupozea mara kwa mara na zinazohusiana na maji.

English: Many households rely on basic measures such as fans, drinking more water and wearing lighter clothing.
Kiswahili: Kaya nyingi hutegemea hatua za kimsingi kama vile feni, kunywa maji zaidi na kuvaa nguo nyepesi.

English: Awareness of heat risks and potential adaptation measures appears low, while financial constraints, lack of technical skills and insecure land tenure discourage investments to make homes safer and more resilient to rising temperatures.
Kiswahili: Uelewa wa hatari za joto na hatua zinazowezekana za kukabiliana na hali hiyo unaonekana kuwa mdogo, ilhali vikwazo vya kifedha, ukosefu wa ujuzi wa kiufundi na umiliki wa ardhi usio salama hukatisha tamaa uwekezaji ili kufanya nyumba kuwa salama na kustahimili joto linaloongezeka.

English: The impacts of chronic heat are far-reaching and cumulative, affecting health, daily activities, livelihoods and productivity.
Kiswahili: Madhara ya joto sugu ni makubwa na yanaongezeka, yanayoathiri afya, shughuli za kila siku, maisha na tija.

English: Long-term exposure can lead to persistent heat stress and exhaustion, worsen cardiovascular and respiratory conditions, increase mental health challenges and contribute to the development of chronic kidney disease.
Kiswahili: Mfiduo wa muda mrefu unaweza kusababisha mfadhaiko wa joto na uchovu unaoendelea, hali mbaya ya moyo na mishipa na kupumua, kuongeza changamoto za afya ya akili na kuchangia ukuaji wa ugonjwa sugu wa figo.

English: The burdenfalls disproportionately on vulnerable groups, particularly people living in poor-quality housing, low-income households, individuals with pre-existing health conditions and workers exposed to extreme temperatures.
Kiswahili: The burdenfalls disproportionately on vulnerable groups, particularly people living in poor-quality housing, low-income households, individuals with pre-existing health conditions and workers exposed to extreme temperatures.

English: Tackling the underlying drivers of vulnerability and supporting livelihoods can help communities strengthen their resilience and improve the effectiveness of heat adaptation and management efforts.
Kiswahili: Kukabiliana na vichochezi vya msingi vya kuathirika na kutegemeza riziki kunaweza kusaidia jamii kuimarisha uthabiti wao na kuboresha ufanisi wa kukabiliana na joto na juhudi za usimamizi.

English: Although heat-related impacts may initially affect individual sectors, risks are amplified by the interdependence of critical systems and the potential forcompoundingandcascadingeffects.
Kiswahili: Ingawa athari zinazohusiana na joto zinaweza kuathiri sekta binafsi hapo awali, hatari huzidishwa na kutegemeana kwa mifumo muhimu na uwezekano wa kuzidisha na athari mbaya.

English: Heat also places increasing strain on energy systems by affecting transmission infrastructure and cooling capacity at the same time that electricity demand rises, increasing the risk of power outages.
Kiswahili: Joto pia huweka mkazo unaoongezeka kwenye mifumo ya nishati kwa kuathiri miundombinu ya usambazaji na uwezo wa kupoeza wakati huo huo mahitaji ya umeme yanaongezeka, na kuongeza hatari ya kukatika kwa umeme.

English: Even when failures are not sudden or catastrophic, prolonged heat can gradually weaken thereliability, efficiency and resilienceof essential services.
Kiswahili: Hata kama kushindwa si kwa ghafla au janga, joto la muda mrefu linaweza kudhoofisha utegemezi, ufanisi na uthabiti wa huduma muhimu hatua kwa hatua.

English: If adaptation measures are not accelerated, losses linked to health impacts, declining labour productivity and rising cooling demands are expected to increase significantly in the coming decades.
Kiswahili: If adaptation measures are not accelerated, losses linked to health impacts, declining labour productivity and rising cooling demands are expected to increase significantly in the coming decades.

English: Chronic heat's cumulative and sustained effects contribute to a significant total burden on health and society.
Kiswahili: Madhara sugu na ya kudumu ya joto huchangia mzigo mkubwa kwa afya na jamii.

English: Effective management encompasses climate-resilient cities, sustainable farming, better water systems, and stronger regional cooperation to support communities in hotter conditions.
Kiswahili: Usimamizi unaofaa unajumuisha miji inayostahimili hali ya hewa, kilimo endelevu, mifumo bora ya maji, na ushirikiano thabiti wa kikanda ili kusaidia jamii zilizo katika hali ya joto zaidi.

English: This Acceleration Plan focuses on women and newborns who already reach health facilities, where the potential for rapid and measurable impact is greatest.
Kiswahili: Mpango huu wa Kuongeza Kasi unalenga wanawake na watoto wachanga ambao tayari wanafika kwenye vituo vya afya, ambapo uwezekano wa athari za haraka na zinazoweza kupimika ni kubwa zaidi.

English: It is grounded in WHO normative guidance, Kenya’s EWENE scorecard priorities, and recent performance reviews, and identifies quick wins and catalytic reforms to close the most urgent gaps in quality, readiness, and equity of care.
Kiswahili: Imejikita katika mwongozo wa kawaida wa WHO, vipaumbele vya kadi ya alama ya EWENE ya Kenya, na hakiki za hivi majuzi za utendakazi, na kubainisha ushindi wa haraka na mageuzi ya kichocheo ili kuziba mapengo ya haraka zaidi katika ubora, utayari na usawa wa huduma.

English: Enablers for success include strong political leadership, targeted investments in high- burden counties,integration of digital health solutions, gender- responsive programming, and sustained community engagement.
Kiswahili: Viwezeshaji vya mafanikio ni pamoja na uongozi dhabiti wa kisiasa, uwekezaji unaolengwa katika kaunti zenye mzigo mkubwa, muunganisho wa suluhu za afya za kidijitali, programu zinazozingatia jinsia, na ushirikiano endelevu wa jamii.

English: Kenya has five years to meet its Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and Kenya Health Policy targets for maternal and newborn health.
Kiswahili: Kenya ina miaka mitano kufikia Malengo yake ya Maendeleo Endelevu (SDGs) na shabaha za Sera ya Afya ya Kenya kwa afya ya uzazi na watoto wachanga.

English: This Acceleration Plan serves asboth atechnical blueprint and adelivery contract, anchored in WHO guidance,EWENE scorecard priorities, and Kenya’s healthpolicy framework.
Kiswahili: Mpango huu wa Kuongeza Kasi unatumika kama mwongozo wa kiufundi na mkataba wa uwasilishaji, unaozingatia mwongozo wa WHO, vipaumbele vya kadi za alama za EWENE, na mfumo wa sera ya afya ya Kenya.

English: A Self-Help Group can be defined as a peer-led, culturally accepted mechanism to build financial independence, resilience, and mutual support.
Kiswahili: Kundi la Kujisaidia linaweza kufafanuliwa kama utaratibu unaoongozwa na rika, unaokubalika kitamaduni ili kujenga uhuru wa kifedha, uthabiti na usaidizi wa pande zote.

English: Members pool savings to provide micro-loans, share skills and provide mutual social support, providing a vital vehicle for financial inclusion and poverty reduction in many communities.
Kiswahili: Wanachama hukusanya akiba ili kutoa mikopo midogo midogo, ujuzi wa kubadilishana na kutoa usaidizi wa kijamii, kutoa chombo muhimu cha ushirikishwaji wa kifedha na kupunguza umaskini katika jamii nyingi.

English: Recha*, a group member, shared that since Acted started supporting their association in 2025, the situation is turning around.
Kiswahili: Recha*, mwanakikundi, alishiriki kwamba tangu Acted ianze kuunga mkono chama chao mwaka 2025, hali inabadilika.

English: Their group’s progress is stirring interest from other community members, inspiring them to learn from the Kariamakeris Women’s group.
Kiswahili: Maendeleo ya kikundi chao yanachochea shauku kutoka kwa wanajamii wengine, na kuwatia moyo kujifunza kutoka kwa kikundi cha Wanawake cha Kariamakeris.

English: Across many Kenyan communities, and within Africa at large, women hold the primary responsibility for managing essential family needs such as water, food, fuel and healthcare.
Kiswahili: Katika jamii nyingi za Kenya, na ndani ya Afrika kwa ujumla, wanawake wana jukumu la msingi la kusimamia mahitaji muhimu ya familia kama vile maji, chakula, mafuta na huduma za afya.

English: Despite this responsibility, they frequently have less control and more insecure access to resources; influenced by various interconnected cultural, ecological, economic, political and gendered aspects.
Kiswahili: Licha ya jukumu hili, mara nyingi wana udhibiti mdogo na ufikiaji usio salama wa rasilimali; kuathiriwa na nyanja mbalimbali zilizounganishwa za kitamaduni, ikolojia, kiuchumi, kisiasa na kijinsia.

English: The Kenyan government shows commitment to promote the effective participation of women across all sectors.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya inaonyesha kujitolea kukuza ushiriki wa wanawake katika sekta zote.

English: However, women, especially from historically marginalised counties like Turkana and West Pokot, have a shared reality of retrogressive customs, widespread resource scarcity, gender-based violence, among other issues that have denied them social, economic, educational, and leadership opportunities.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, wanawake, hasa kutoka kaunti zilizotengwa kihistoria kama vile Turkana na Pokot Magharibi, wana uhalisia wa pamoja wa mila zilizorudi nyuma, uhaba mkubwa wa rasilimali, unyanyasaji wa kijinsia, miongoni mwa masuala mengine ambayo yamewanyima fursa za kijamii, kiuchumi, kielimu na uongozi.

English: Aiming to contribute to the creation of opportunities for women in Kenya, and women in similar contexts in Morocco and Cote d’Ivoire, Acted, with the support of The Coca-Cola Foundation (TCCF), launched the SHE-GROW Africa Project.
Kiswahili: Ikilenga kuchangia katika uundaji wa fursa kwa wanawake nchini Kenya, na wanawake katika mazingira sawa nchini Morocco na Cote d'Ivoire, Acted, kwa usaidizi wa Wakfu wa Coca-Cola (TCCF), ilizindua Mradi wa SHE-GROW Afrika.

English: SHE-GROW (a contraction of “Sustainable Holistic Empowerment: Growing Economic Resilience Opportunities for Women in Rural Africa”) is an 18-month initiative aimed at strengthening the economic resilience of women and their communities in Kenya, Côte d’Ivoire and Morocco.
Kiswahili: SHE-GROW (ufupisho wa “Uwezeshaji Endelevu wa Kijumla: Kukua Fursa za Kustahimili Kiuchumi kwa Wanawake katika Afrika Vijijini”) ni mpango wa miezi 18 unaolenga kuimarisha uthabiti wa kiuchumi wa wanawake na jumuiya zao nchini Kenya, Côte d’Ivoire na Morocco.

English: Eighteen communities across the 3 countries, selected for their vulnerability to climate change and limited access to economic opportunities, are targeted.
Kiswahili: Jumuiya kumi na nane katika nchi 3, zilizochaguliwa kwa uwezekano wao wa kuathiriwa na mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa na ufikiaji mdogo wa fursa za kiuchumi, zinalengwa.

English: The project is aimed at ensuring 600+ women: have enhanced leadership, financial management and business skills; can develop and launch climate-resilient entrepreneurial initiatives in selected, sustainable value chains; and, are connected with markets and financial support to scale and sustain their enterprises.
Kiswahili: Mradi unalenga kuhakikisha wanawake 600+: wameimarishwa uongozi, usimamizi wa fedha na ujuzi wa biashara; inaweza kuendeleza na kuzindua mipango ya ujasiriamali inayostahimili hali ya hewa katika minyororo iliyochaguliwa na endelevu ya thamani; na, zimeunganishwa na masoko na usaidizi wa kifedha ili kuongeza na kuendeleza biashara zao.

English: In Kenya, the project is implemented within 9 communities in West Pokot and Turkana Counties, building on the progress created with women’s groups supported under an earlier agriculture and livelihoods project, THRIVE.
Kiswahili: Nchini Kenya, mradi huu unatekelezwa ndani ya jamii 9 katika Kaunti za Pokot Magharibi na Turkana, kwa kuzingatia maendeleo yaliyoundwa na vikundi vya wanawake vilivyoungwa mkono chini ya mradi wa awali wa kilimo na maisha, THRIVE.

English: Drylands Learning and Capacity-Building Initiative (DLCI) is Acted’s national partner in this action, bringing on-board its extensive knowledge and experience of dryland communities and gender dynamics of the region.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Kujifunza na Kujenga Uwezo wa Drylands (DLCI) ni mshirika wa kitaifa wa Kaimu katika hatua hii, na kuleta ujuzi na uzoefu wake wa kina wa jumuiya za nchi kavu na mienendo ya kijinsia ya eneo hili.

English: As we use the savings and loan money to educate our girls, the girls will learn a lot in school to support our community.
Kiswahili: Tunapotumia pesa za akiba na mkopo kusomesha wasichana wetu, wasichana watajifunza mengi shuleni kusaidia jamii yetu.

English: Almost halfway through the project, Acted Kenya continues to deliver tailored financial literacy training to women’s Self-Help Groups, each comprising about 30 to –40 members.
Kiswahili: Takriban katikati ya mradi huu, Acted Kenya inaendelea kutoa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa kifedha kwa Vikundi vya Wanawake vya Kujisaidia, kila moja likijumuisha wanachama 30 hadi -40.

English: Recognising that many participants were unable to continue their education beyond the basic level, the sessions combine foundational and intermediate financial management skills and are adapted to the women’s everyday priorities and economic realities.
Kiswahili: Kwa kutambua kwamba washiriki wengi hawakuweza kuendelea na elimu yao zaidi ya kiwango cha msingi, vikao vinachanganya ujuzi wa msingi na wa kati wa usimamizi wa fedha na huchukuliwa kwa vipaumbele vya kila siku vya wanawake na hali halisi ya kiuchumi.

English: Alongside these trainings, the SHG members are participating in business development sessions designed to help them identify viable livelihood opportunities and strengthen their capacity to manage collective enterprises.
Kiswahili: Kando na mafunzo haya, wanachama wa SHG wanashiriki katika vikao vya maendeleo ya biashara vilivyoundwa ili kuwasaidia kutambua fursa zinazowezekana za maisha na kuimarisha uwezo wao wa kusimamia biashara za pamoja.

English: Members contribute a portion of their savings toward the selected activity, while Acted provides matching support or the materials required, based on the needs outlined in the proposal.
Kiswahili: Wanachama huchangia sehemu ya akiba zao kwa shughuli iliyochaguliwa, huku Acted inatoa usaidizi unaolingana au nyenzo zinazohitajika, kulingana na mahitaji yaliyoainishwa katika pendekezo.

English: Through this approach, the project aims to strengthen women’s financial decision-making skills, encourage savings and investment practices, and support the development of sustainable income-generating opportunities.
Kiswahili: Kupitia mbinu hii, mradi unalenga kuimarisha ujuzi wa wanawake wa kufanya maamuzi ya kifedha, kuhimiza mazoea ya kuweka akiba na uwekezaji, na kusaidia maendeleo ya fursa endelevu za kuzalisha mapato.

English: To encourage community-wide ownership and create an enabling environment for women’s economic empowerment, young men and male relatives of SHG members participate in complementary livelihood skills training alongside the women’s groups.
Kiswahili: Ili kuhimiza umiliki wa jamii nzima na kuweka mazingira wezeshi kwa uwezeshaji wa wanawake kiuchumi, vijana wa kiume na wa kiume wa wanachama wa SHG hushiriki katika mafunzo ya stadi za kujikimu kimaisha pamoja na vikundi vya wanawake.

English: Training modules for the men include basic marketing strategies tailored to local markets; effective price negotiation techniques; customer engagement and relationship building; and, ethical and inclusive business practices.
Kiswahili: Moduli za mafunzo kwa wanaume ni pamoja na mikakati ya kimsingi ya uuzaji iliyoundwa na masoko ya ndani; mbinu bora za mazungumzo ya bei; ushiriki wa wateja na kujenga uhusiano; na, maadili na mazoea ya biashara jumuishi.

English: In the longer term, these group enterprises have the potential to increase household income, strengthen group cohesion, and contribute to greater economic resilience among participating women and their communities.
Kiswahili: Kwa muda mrefu, biashara hizi za vikundi zina uwezo wa kuongeza mapato ya kaya, kuimarisha mshikamano wa vikundi, na kuchangia uthabiti mkubwa wa kiuchumi kati ya wanawake wanaoshiriki na jamii zao.

English: From stronger savings practices to the development of group businesses, women in Turkana and West Pokot are gaining the skills, resources and confidence to improve their economic opportunities through the SHE-GROW Africa project, laying the foundation for more resilient households and communities.
Kiswahili: Kuanzia mazoea madhubuti ya kuweka akiba hadi maendeleo ya biashara za vikundi, wanawake huko Turkana na Pokot Magharibi wanapata ujuzi, rasilimali na imani ya kuboresha fursa zao za kiuchumi kupitia mradi wa SHE-GROW Afrika, kuweka msingi kwa kaya na jumuiya zinazostahimili zaidi.

English: However, moderate hunger and borderline food consumption persist, indicating continued food security challenges for some households.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, njaa ya wastani na ulaji wa chakula wa mipakani unaendelea, jambo linaloashiria kuendelea kuwepo kwa changamoto za usalama wa chakula kwa baadhi ya kaya.

English: Coupled with a reduction in the use of emergency coping strategies, these trends suggest that the assistance helped ease immediate financial pressures and reduce reliance on negative coping.
Kiswahili: Sambamba na kupunguzwa kwa utumiaji wa mikakati ya kukabiliana na hali ya dharura, mienendo hii inapendekeza kwamba usaidizi ulisaidia kupunguza shinikizo la haraka la kifedha na kupunguza utegemezi wa kukabiliana na hali mbaya.

English: However, 32% of households still reported being unaware of available channels, highlighting the need for improved communication.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, asilimia 32 ya kaya bado ziliripoti kutofahamu njia zinazopatikana, na hivyo kuonyesha hitaji la kuboreshwa kwa mawasiliano.

English: Kenya and Rwanda have reached an important milestone in the fight against antimicrobial resistance (AMR), strengthening their ability to track where drug-resistant infections are emerging, and how they are spreading.
Kiswahili: Kenya na Rwanda zimefikia hatua muhimu katika mapambano dhidi ya ukinzani wa viua vijidudu (AMR), kuimarisha uwezo wao wa kufuatilia ni wapi magonjwa sugu ya dawa yanajitokeza, na jinsi yanavyoenea.

English: Through improvements to their surveillance systems, both countries are now generating more detailed information to guide treatment decisions, strengthen public health action and help protect the effectiveness of life-saving medicines.
Kiswahili: Kupitia maboresho ya mifumo yao ya uchunguzi, nchi zote mbili sasa zinatoa maelezo ya kina zaidi ili kuongoza maamuzi ya matibabu, kuimarisha hatua za afya ya umma na kusaidia kulinda ufanisi wa dawa zinazookoa maisha.

English: AMR is making infections harder to treat, increasing the risk of disease spread, severe illness and death, while placing growing pressure on health systems worldwide.
Kiswahili: AMR inafanya maambukizo kuwa magumu kutibu, na kuongeza hatari ya kuenea kwa magonjwa, ugonjwa mbaya na kifo, huku ikiweka shinikizo kubwa kwenye mifumo ya afya ulimwenguni.

English: Effective surveillance is essential for understanding where resistance is occurring, how it is evolving and what actions are needed to respond.
Kiswahili: Ufuatiliaji unaofaa ni muhimu ili kuelewa ni wapi upinzani unatokea, jinsi unavyoendelea na ni hatua gani zinahitajika ili kujibu.

English: A key part of this progress has been the transition to individual-level reporting through the WHO Global Antimicrobial Resistance and Use Surveillance System (GLASS).
Kiswahili: Sehemu muhimu ya maendeleo haya imekuwa mpito kwa kuripoti kwa kiwango cha mtu binafsi kupitia Mfumo wa Ufuatiliaji wa Kimataifa wa Kupambana na Viini na Utumiaji wa WHO (GLASS).

English: This allows countries to collect and analyse more detailed information on resistance trends, helping health authorities make better-informed decisions on treatment, prevention and antimicrobial stewardship.
Kiswahili: Hili huruhusu nchi kukusanya na kuchambua maelezo ya kina zaidi kuhusu mienendo ya ukinzani, kusaidia mamlaka za afya kufanya maamuzi yenye ufahamu zaidi kuhusu matibabu, uzuiaji na usimamizi wa antimicrobial.

English: The progress demonstrated by Kenya and Rwanda shows that countries can successfully strengthen their data systems and generate evidence that informs policy, improves patient care and supports antimicrobial stewardship,” said Dr Ali Ahmed Yahaya, Antimicrobial Resistance Team Lead at the WHO Regional Office for Africa.
Kiswahili: Maendeleo yaliyoonyeshwa na Kenya na Rwanda yanaonyesha kuwa nchi zinaweza kuimarisha mifumo yao ya data kwa mafanikio na kutoa ushahidi unaofahamisha sera, kuboresha utunzaji wa wagonjwa na kuunga mkono uwakili wa dawa za kuua viini,” alisema Dk Ali Ahmed Yahaya, Kiongozi wa Timu ya Kupambana na Viuavidudu katika Ofisi ya Kanda ya WHO ya Afrika.

English: Kenya’s journey shows how sustained investment and careful planning can build stronger public health intelligence over time.
Kiswahili: Safari ya Kenya inaonyesha jinsi uwekezaji endelevu na mipango makini inavyoweza kujenga akili ya afya ya umma kwa wakati.

English: What began in 2017 with two model surveillance sites has expanded into a nationwide network of 32 surveillance sites across 27 counties and multiple One Health sectors.
Kiswahili: Kilichoanza mwaka wa 2017 na tovuti mbili za mfano za uchunguzi kimepanuka na kuwa mtandao wa kitaifa wa tovuti 32 za uchunguzi katika kaunti 27 na sekta nyingi za Afya Moja.

English: Kenya first submitted AMR data to GLASS in 2021 and transitioned to individual-level reporting in 2025.
Kiswahili: Kenya iliwasilisha data ya AMR kwa GLASS kwa mara ya kwanza mwaka wa 2021 na ikabadilika hadi kuripoti kiwango cha mtu binafsi mwaka wa 2025.

English: Through its Central Data Warehouse, the country now integrates AMR surveillance, antimicrobial use and antimicrobial consumption data, providing a more comprehensive picture of national AMR patterns.
Kiswahili: Kupitia Ghala lake Kuu la Data, nchi sasa inaunganisha ufuatiliaji wa AMR, matumizi ya dawa za kuua viini na data ya matumizi ya antimicrobial, ikitoa picha ya kina zaidi ya mifumo ya kitaifa ya AMR.

English: The country’s progress has been supported by strong governance structures, standardized data collection tools, laboratory information systems, regular data quality reviews and multidisciplinary collaboration involving laboratory, data and informatics teams.
Kiswahili: Maendeleo ya nchi yameungwa mkono na miundo thabiti ya utawala, zana sanifu za ukusanyaji wa takwimu, mifumo ya taarifa za maabara, ukaguzi wa mara kwa mara wa ubora wa data na ushirikiano wa fani mbalimbali unaohusisha timu za maabara, data na taarifa.

English: A phased approach allowed Kenya to strengthen systems and improve data quality before expanding surveillance.
Kiswahili: Mbinu ya hatua kwa hatua iliruhusu Kenya kuimarisha mifumo na kuboresha ubora wa data kabla ya kupanua ufuatiliaji.

English: Between 2021 and 2025, more than 100 000 AMR surveillance records were collected, with 9039 records submitted to GLASS in 2025.
Kiswahili: Kati ya 2021 na 2025, zaidi ya rekodi 100,000 za uchunguzi wa AMR zilikusanywa, na rekodi 9039 ziliwasilishwa kwa GLASS mnamo 2025.

English: The data generated are helping us better understand resistance trends and support evidence-based decision-making,” said Susan Githii, Country GLASS Focal Person and AMR Surveillance Focal Point, Kenya.
Kiswahili: Data inayotolewa inatusaidia kuelewa vyema mienendo ya upinzani na kuunga mkono uamuzi unaotegemea ushahidi,” alisema Susan Githii, Country GLASS Focal Person na AMR Surveillance Focal Point, Kenya.

English: Rwanda’s experience highlights the importance of collaboration in building stronger surveillance systems.
Kiswahili: Uzoefu wa Rwanda unaonyesha umuhimu wa ushirikiano katika kujenga mifumo imara ya ufuatiliaji.

English: Since enrolling in GLASS in 2022 and submitting its first AMR data in 2023, the country has worked closely with hospitals, national institutions and technical partners to strengthen data collection and reporting.
Kiswahili: Tangu kujiandikisha katika GLASS mwaka wa 2022 na kuwasilisha data yake ya kwanza ya AMR mnamo 2023, nchi imefanya kazi kwa karibu na hospitali, taasisi za kitaifa na washirika wa kiufundi ili kuimarisha ukusanyaji na kuripoti data.

English: During the 2025 GLASS reporting cycle, Rwanda began reporting both aggregate and individual-level data, ensuring continuity while transitioning to more detailed surveillance reporting.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa mzunguko wa kuripoti wa GLASS wa 2025, Rwanda ilianza kuripoti data ya jumla na ya kiwango cha mtu binafsi, kuhakikisha uendelevu wakati wa mpito kwa ripoti ya kina zaidi ya ufuatiliaji.

English: The transition was supported by strong leadership from the Ministry of Health and the Rwanda Biomedical Centre, close collaboration among participating hospitals, the use of standardized tools such as BacLink and WHONET, and technical support from WHO Headquarters and the WHO Regional Office for Africa.
Kiswahili: Mpito huo uliungwa mkono na uongozi dhabiti kutoka Wizara ya Afya na Kituo cha Matibabu cha Rwanda, ushirikiano wa karibu kati ya hospitali zinazoshiriki, matumizi ya zana sanifu kama vile BacLink na WHONET, na usaidizi wa kiufundi kutoka Makao Makuu ya WHO na Ofisi ya Kanda ya WHO ya Afrika.

English: The transition to individual-level data reporting was not without challenges.
Kiswahili: Mpito kwa kuripoti data kwa kiwango cha mtu binafsi haukuwa na changamoto.

English: Kenya identified gaps related to laboratory information system interoperability, missing patient variables, workforce capacity for data validation and initial concerns around data privacy.
Kiswahili: Kenya ilitambua mapengo yanayohusiana na ushirikiano wa mfumo wa taarifa za maabara, vigezo vinavyokosekana kwa wagonjwa, uwezo wa wafanyakazi wa kuthibitisha data na masuala ya awali kuhusu faragha ya data.

English: Rwanda faced challenges related to manual data collection in some facilities, limited human resources for data management and a lack of interoperability among hospital information systems.
Kiswahili: Rwanda ilikabiliwa na changamoto zinazohusiana na ukusanyaji wa data kwa mikono katika baadhi ya vituo, rasilimali watu wachache kwa usimamizi wa data na ukosefu wa mwingiliano kati ya mifumo ya taarifa za hospitali.

English: Despite these obstacles, both countries demonstrated that progress is possible through structured planning, strong coordination, standardized tools, data quality assurance and sustained partner support.
Kiswahili: Licha ya vikwazo hivi, nchi zote mbili zilionyesha kuwa maendeleo yanawezekana kupitia mipango iliyopangwa, uratibu thabiti, zana sanifu, uhakikisho wa ubora wa data na usaidizi endelevu wa washirika.

English: To support countries in strengthening AMR surveillance and preparing data submissions to GLASS, the WHO Regional Office for Africa, in collaboration with the WHO Headquarters GLASS team, continues to provide technical guidance, capacity-building and opportunities for peer learning.
Kiswahili: Ili kusaidia nchi katika kuimarisha ufuatiliaji wa AMR na kuandaa mawasilisho ya data kwa GLASS, Ofisi ya WHO Kanda ya Afrika, kwa ushirikiano na timu ya GLASS ya Makao Makuu ya WHO, inaendelea kutoa mwongozo wa kiufundi, kujenga uwezo na fursa za kujifunza rika.

English: The experiences of Kenya and Rwanda demonstrate how better data can help countries stay ahead of one of the most significant public health threats of our time.
Kiswahili: Matukio ya Kenya na Rwanda yanaonyesha jinsi data bora inaweza kusaidia nchi kusalia mbele ya matishio makubwa zaidi ya afya ya umma katika wakati wetu.

English: However, excessively high rainfall amounts may also raise the risk of waterlogging and localized crop stress, potentially affecting early crop development in poorly drained areas.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, kiasi cha mvua nyingi kupita kiasi kinaweza pia kuongeza hatari ya kujaa maji na mkazo wa mimea iliyojanibishwa, ambayo inaweza kuathiri maendeleo ya mapema ya mazao katika maeneo yenye unyevu hafifu.

English: The ongoing conflict in the Middle East poses risks to the country’s agricultural sector by disrupting trade flows and supply chains and increasing input costs.
Kiswahili: Mzozo unaoendelea katika Mashariki ya Kati unaleta hatari kwa sekta ya kilimo nchini humo kwa kuvuruga mtiririko wa biashara na minyororo ya ugavi na kuongeza gharama za pembejeo.

English: Imports of fertilizers have already been delayed, affecting their timely application at the beginning of the 2026 cropping season, particularly in market‑oriented agricultural areas of western parts of the country.
Kiswahili: Uagizaji wa mbolea tayari umecheleweshwa, na hivyo kuathiri utumiaji wake kwa wakati mwanzoni mwa msimu wa mazao wa 2026, haswa katika maeneo ya kilimo yenye mwelekeo wa soko wa maeneo ya magharibi mwa nchi.

English: Crops in these areas are harvested in July and August, and compared to westernunimodalhigh potential areas, agricultural systems are less input intensive.
Kiswahili: Mazao katika maeneo haya huvunwa mnamo Julai na Agosti, na ikilinganishwa na maeneo yenye uwezekano wa westernunimodalhigh, mifumo ya kilimo haihitaji pembejeo nyingi.

English: However, cereal production from these areas accounts for only a small share of the national output.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, uzalishaji wa nafaka kutoka maeneo haya unachangia sehemu ndogo tu ya pato la taifa.

English: However, in northeastern and some eastern areas (Mandera, Wajir, Garissa and Tana River counties) pasture conditions in March remained below‑average following a severe drought in late 2025 (Vegetation Condition Index map).
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, katika maeneo ya kaskazini-mashariki na baadhi ya mashariki (kaunti za Mandera, Wajir, Garissa na Tana River) hali ya malisho mnamo Machi ilisalia chini- wastani kufuatia ukame mkali mwishoni mwa 2025 (ramani ya Kielezo cha Hali ya Uoto).

English: By contrast, in the drought-affected counties, body conditions were assessed to be poor in Mandera County and from poor to fair in Wajir, Garissa and Tana River counties, although above‑average seasonal rains are supporting pasture and fodder regeneration, contributing to gradual improvements.
Kiswahili: Kinyume chake, katika kaunti zilizoathiriwa na ukame, hali ya mwili ilitathminiwa kuwa mbaya katika Kaunti ya Mandera na kutoka hali duni hadi ya haki katika kaunti za Wajir, Garissa na Tana River, ingawa mvua za msimu wa juu-wastani zinasaidia ufufuaji wa malisho na malisho, na kuchangia uboreshaji wa taratibu.

English: In pastoral areas, livestock prices generally declined between late 2025 and early 2026 as animal body conditions deteriorated.
Kiswahili: Katika maeneo ya wafugaji, bei ya mifugo kwa ujumla ilipungua kati ya mwishoni mwa 2025 na mapema 2026 huku hali ya miili ya wanyama ikizidi kuwa mbaya.

English: By contrast, in drought-affected northeastern areas, prices decreased more sharply reflecting the substantial deterioration of animal body condition.
Kiswahili: Kinyume chake, katika maeneo ya kaskazini-mashariki yaliyoathiriwa na ukame, bei ilipungua kwa kasi zaidi ikionyesha kuzorota kwa hali ya mwili wa wanyama.

English: The high levels and prevalence of food insecurity are mainly due to the poor performance of the 2025 October‑Decembershort‑rains,which severely affected crops and livestock.
Kiswahili: Viwango vya juu na kuenea kwa uhaba wa chakula kunatokana zaidi na utendaji duni wa mvua za 2025 Oktoba-Desemba 2025, ambazo ziliathiri vibaya mazao na mifugo.

English: Households in drought‑affected Wajir, Mandera and Tana River counties are of particular concern.
Kiswahili: Kaya katika kaunti zilizoathiriwa na ukame za Wajir, Mandera na Tana River zina wasiwasi mkubwa.

English: These three counties also account for about 65 percent of the total number of people estimated in IPC Phase 4 (Emergency).
Kiswahili: Kaunti hizi tatu pia zinachukua takriban asilimia 65 ya jumla ya idadi ya watu wanaokadiriwa katika IPC Awamu ya 4 (Dharura).

English: The new Strategy, developed with technical support from the United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR), provides a comprehensive framework to strengthen financial resilience through a shift from reactive, crisis-driven financing to proactive, risk-informed financial preparedness through 2030.
Kiswahili: Mkakati huo mpya, uliotayarishwa kwa msaada wa kiufundi kutoka Ofisi ya Umoja wa Mataifa ya Kupunguza Hatari za Maafa (UNDRR), unatoa mfumo mpana wa kuimarisha ustahimilivu wa kifedha kupitia kuhama kutoka kwa ufadhili tendaji, unaotokana na shida hadi utayarishaji wa kifedha unaozingatia hatari hadi 2030.

English: The central objective of the strategy is to enhance the financial capacity of national and county governments to effectively manage disaster risks along the disaster risk management (DRM) continuum.
Kiswahili: Lengo kuu la mkakati huo ni kuimarisha uwezo wa kifedha wa serikali za kitaifa na kaunti ili kudhibiti ipasavyo hatari za maafa katika mwendelezo wa usimamizi wa hatari za maafa (DRM).

English: Kenya’s leadership in disaster risk reduction comes at a time when the country faces increasing climate-related challenges.
Kiswahili: Uongozi wa Kenya katika kupunguza hatari ya majanga unakuja wakati nchi hiyo inakabiliwa na changamoto zinazoongezeka zinazohusiana na hali ya hewa.

English: Over recent decades, droughts and floods have severely impacted communities, particularly in the Arid and Semi-Arid Lands (ASAL) regions.
Kiswahili: Katika miongo ya hivi majuzi, ukame na mafuriko yameathiri sana jamii, hasa katika maeneo ya Ardhi Kame na Nusu Kame (ASAL).

English: In 2024, the March–April–May floods affected around 410,000 people, claimed 315 lives, and caused damage amounting to 187 billion Kenyan Shillings¹.
Kiswahili: Mnamo 2024, mafuriko ya Machi-Aprili-Mei yaliathiri takriban watu 410,000, na kupoteza maisha ya 315, na kusababisha uharibifu wa Shilingi bilioni 187 za Kenya¹.

English: Building on lessons from the DRF Strategy 2018–2022, this updated Strategy expands beyond risk retention and risk transfer to incorporate investments for risk reduction.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuzingatia mafunzo kutoka kwa Mkakati wa DRF 2018–2022, Mkakati huu uliosasishwa unapanuka zaidi ya uhifadhi wa hatari na uhamishaji wa hatari ili kujumuisha uwekezaji wa kupunguza hatari.

English: It is cross-cutting in nature, designed to be multi-hazard and multi-sector, and encompasses gender equality and social inclusion.
Kiswahili: Ni mtambuka kimaumbile, iliyoundwa kuwa ya hatari nyingi na sekta nyingi, na inajumuisha usawa wa kijinsia na ushirikishwaji wa kijamii.

English: The Strategy complements the Disaster Risk Management Strategy 2025–2030, which established a long-term framework for reducing disaster risks and strengthening resilience across Kenya.
Kiswahili: Mkakati huu unakamilisha Mkakati wa Kudhibiti Hatari za Maafa 2025–2030, ambao ulianzisha mfumo wa muda mrefu wa kupunguza hatari za maafa na kuimarisha ustahimilivu kote nchini Kenya.

English: UNDRR also supported the National Treasury in developing adisaster risk reduction and climate change adaptation budget tagging (DCBT)system, which helped Kenya strengthen its ability to track and allocate resources for resilience.
Kiswahili: UNDRR pia iliunga mkono Hazina ya Kitaifa katika kuandaa mfumo wa kupunguza hatari ya maafa na mfumo wa kuweka alama za bajeti ya kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya tabianchi (DCBT), ambao ulisaidia Kenya kuimarisha uwezo wake wa kufuatilia na kutenga rasilimali kwa ajili ya kustahimili.

English: Targeted consultations with civil society organizations, non-governmental organizations, construction practitioners, the private sector, and development partners have ensured that the strategy reflects broad stakeholder consensus.
Kiswahili: Mashauriano yaliyolengwa na mashirika ya kiraia, mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali, watendaji wa ujenzi, sekta binafsi, na washirika wa maendeleo yamehakikisha kuwa mkakati huo unaonyesha maelewano mapana ya wadau.

English: The Strategy was developed through a phased, consultative process from 2025 to 2026.
Kiswahili: Mkakati huu uliandaliwa kupitia mchakato wa mashauriano wa hatua kwa hatua kutoka 2025 hadi 2026.

English: It involved collaborating with multiple partner organisations, with support provided by UNDRR.
Kiswahili: Ilihusisha kushirikiana na mashirika mengi ya washirika, kwa usaidizi uliotolewa na UNDRR.

English: Looking ahead, UNDRR plans to offer continued support to Kenya’s institutional DRM capacity, including by advancing its cost–benefit analysis of DRR investments.
Kiswahili: Tukiangalia mbeleni, UNDRR inapanga kuendelea kutoa usaidizi kwa uwezo wa kitaasisi wa DRM wa Kenya, ikiwa ni pamoja na kuendeleza uchanganuzi wake wa gharama-manufaa ya uwekezaji wa DRR.

English: This work will ensure that future investments are evidence-based, economically sound, and aligned with national priorities.
Kiswahili: Kazi hii itahakikisha kuwa uwekezaji wa siku zijazo ni wa msingi wa ushahidi, mzuri kiuchumi, na unaendana na vipaumbele vya kitaifa.

English: Good financing decisions depend on good information, on understanding where risks lie, how they evolve, and what they will cost,” said Amjad Abbashar, Chief, UNDRR Regional Office for Africa.
Kiswahili: Maamuzi mazuri ya ufadhili yanategemea taarifa nzuri, kuelewa mahali ambapo hatari zipo, jinsi zinavyobadilika, na zitagharimu nini,” alisema Amjad Abbashar, Mkuu wa Ofisi ya UNDRR ya Kanda ya Afrika.

English: The Act provides a legal foundation for disaster governance in Kenya.
Kiswahili: Sheria inatoa msingi wa kisheria wa udhibiti wa majanga nchini Kenya.

English: It establishes the National Disaster Risk Management Authority and County Disaster Risk Management Committees, tasked with coordinating response, issuing early warnings, and ensuring that resources reach affected communities in a timely manner.
Kiswahili: Inaanzisha Mamlaka ya Kitaifa ya Kudhibiti Hatari ya Maafa na Kamati za Kudhibiti Hatari za Majanga za Kaunti, zilizopewa jukumu la kuratibu majibu, kutoa maonyo ya mapema, na kuhakikisha kuwa rasilimali zinafikia jamii zilizoathiriwa kwa wakati ufaao.

English: Further strengthening the fiscal systems in Kenya, the Division of Revenue Act, 2026. defines how resources are shared between national and county governments and enables counties to finance critical services, including DRM.
Kiswahili: Kuimarisha zaidi mifumo ya kifedha nchini Kenya, Sheria ya Mgawanyo wa Mapato, 2026. inafafanua jinsi rasilimali zinavyogawanywa kati ya serikali za kitaifa na kaunti na kuwezesha kaunti kufadhili huduma muhimu, pamoja na DRM.

English: The launch of the Strategy, alongside these legislative achievements, reflects Kenya’s strong national commitment to resilience, fiscal stability, and inclusive protection for all residents.
Kiswahili: Kuzinduliwa kwa Mkakati huo, pamoja na mafanikio haya ya kisheria, kunaonyesha dhamira dhabiti ya kitaifa ya Kenya ya uthabiti, uthabiti wa kifedha, na ulinzi jumuishi kwa wakaazi wote.

English: It also positions the country as a leader in advancing innovative approaches to disaster risk management in Africa, ensuring that individuals and institutions are empowered to anticipate and respond to disasters before they occur.
Kiswahili: Pia inaiweka nchi kama kiongozi katika kuendeleza mbinu bunifu za udhibiti wa hatari za maafa barani Afrika, kuhakikisha kuwa watu binafsi na taasisi wanawezeshwa kutarajia na kukabiliana na majanga kabla hayajatokea.

English: The analysis is based on information available as of April 30, 2026.
Kiswahili: Uchambuzi huo unatokana na taarifa inayopatikana kuanzia tarehe 30 Aprili 2026.

English: Between 2020 and 2024, Tana River County experienced alternating cycles of drought and flooding, exacerbating displacement patterns.
Kiswahili: Kati ya 2020 na 2024, Kaunti ya Tana River ilikumbwa na mizunguko ya ukame na mafuriko, na hivyo kuzidisha mwelekeo wa watu kuhama makazi yao.

English: Prolonged dry spells between 2020 and 2023 affected crop yields, caused livestock deaths and heightened food insecurity, forcing many households relying on traditional livelihoods to resort to distress migration.
Kiswahili: Muda mrefu wa kiangazi kati ya 2020 na 2023 uliathiri mavuno ya mazao, ulisababisha vifo vya mifugo na kuongezeka kwa uhaba wa chakula, na kulazimisha kaya nyingi zinazotegemea maisha ya jadi kuhamia uhamiaji wa shida.

English: In spring 2024, the county was among the worst affected by El Niño-induced floods, which submerged entire villages, damaging facilities, destroying farmlands and displacing thousands in the process.
Kiswahili: Mnamo majira ya kuchipua 2024, kaunti ilikuwa miongoni mwa nchi zilizoathiriwa zaidi na mafuriko yaliyosababishwa na El Niño, ambayo yalizamisha vijiji vizima, kuharibu vifaa, kuharibu mashamba na kuwahamisha maelfu ya watu katika mchakato huo.

English: This underscores the severity of recurrent climate shocks, particularly flooding along the Tana River Basin, which continues to uproot families, disrupt livelihoods and strain host communities.
Kiswahili: Hii inasisitiza ukali wa majanga ya hali ya hewa yanayotokea mara kwa mara, hasa mafuriko kwenye Bonde la Mto Tana, ambayo yanaendelea kung'oa familia, kutatiza maisha na kuzorotesha jamii zinazowapokea.

English: The Solutions and Mobility Index (SMI) for Tana River County aims to assess progress toward durable solutions for displaced populations (IDPs and IDP returnees).
Kiswahili: Kielezo cha Suluhu na Uhamaji (SMI) cha Kaunti ya Tana River kinalenga kutathmini maendeleo kuelekea suluhu za kudumu kwa watu waliohamishwa makazi yao (IDPs na wanaorejea IDP).

English: Displacement in the county is complex, influenced by natural hazards such as drought or floods, insecurity and resource scarcity.
Kiswahili: Uhamisho wa watu katika kaunti ni changamani, unachangiwa na hatari za asili kama vile ukame au mafuriko, ukosefu wa usalama na uhaba wa rasilimali.

English: By analyzing access to essential services, livelihoods and social cohesion, the SMI identifies gaps in recovery efforts and informs targeted interventions.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuchanganua ufikiaji wa huduma muhimu, riziki na uwiano wa kijamii, SMI inatambua mapungufu katika juhudi za kurejesha na kuarifu afua zinazolengwa.

English: SMI indicators align with the Inter-Agency Standing Committee’s (IASC) Framework for Durable Solutions and integrates data from IOM’s Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM) to ensure a comprehensive, evidence-based approach.
Kiswahili: Viashiria vya SMI vinapatana na Mfumo wa Kamati ya Kudumu ya Wakala wa Kimataifa (IASC) kwa Suluhisho la Kudumu na kuunganisha data kutoka kwa Mfumo wa Ufuatiliaji wa Uhamisho wa IOM (DTM) ili kuhakikisha mbinu ya kina, inayotegemea ushahidi.
